version: 0.4.2
kind: pane
schema_type: object

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.pane
  name: pane.schema
  description: Canonical pane schema defining rectangular UI regions.

spec:
  target_kind: pane
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true
  imports:
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-udi-fields
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-styling
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-control-structures

fields:
  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true
  - name: content_role
    path: content_role
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: x
    path: x
    type: integer
    required: true
  - name: y
    path: y
    type: integer
    required: true
  - name: width
    path: width
    type: integer
    required: true
  - name: height
    path: height
    type: integer
    required: true

# Optional Pane colour_role overrides or for single pane interfaces where no ui-framework file reference exists.
  - name: colour_role
    path: colour_role
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: border_pattern
    path: border_pattern
    type: string
    required: false

# Will add later to allow for specific object items to validate to specific manifest versions
  - name: schema_version
    path: schema_version
    type: string
    required: false

object:
  id: ""
  udi: ""
  content_role: ""
  x: 0
  y: 0
  width: 100
  height: 100
  colour_role: ""
  border_pattern: ""
  schema_version: "0.4.0"
